item.title: For once in my life I entirely agree with a billionaire
item.description:
For once in my life I entirely agree with a billionaire. I just disagree on who it should be applied to and so does he, by the way, because everyone understands the inherent antipathy built into this system. They are being very bold when they forget that liberalism is the right about the only thing protecting them, to pretend that we should apply the same principles to them and to us. It is the only thing preventing us from applying the same exact antipathy that they have for us to them.

item.description:
